commands.analysis: offline parser; no workload or build launched
commands.pairing: inline and explicit --no-inline streams are joined by event identity, never by position alone

interpretation: The qualified denominator is a conservative paired ancestry population, not a timed phase measurement.
The direct inline leaf symbol and owner category are disjoint per qualified sample; inclusive tags intentionally overlap and must not be summed.
Inline-only timer evidence is retained descriptively and is excluded until a matching strict physical timed frame is proven.
scope: paired whole-process cycles:u samples; no-inline physical ancestry is joined to inline source/callsite evidence by exact event identity; no latency, speedup, RSS, allocation, or production claim

selection.ambiguous_policy: multiple exact markers or physical timed frames fail closed
selection.inline_rendering: stage_timed_commit must be exactly one inline frame, ordered before exactly one inline timed_iteration, with source checks
selection.physical_rendering: exactly one non-inline symbol named litchi_perf_baseline::xlsx_managed_compression::benchmark::timed_iteration is required
selection.timed_ip_join: inline timed_iteration IP must equal the strict physical timed_iteration IP
selection.unknown_policy: any unknown frame in either rendering excludes the pair from qualified and inline_only scopes
